exposure: trial of labor to attempt vaginal birth
cohort: 1140 women delivering viable, vertex-presenting twins at or beyond 32 weeks of gestation without contraindication to labor or uterine scar
finding: Women with twin pregnancies undergoing a trial of labor experienced higher odds of maternal morbidity (primarily due to hemorrhage) compared to those electing cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women attempting vaginal delivery had a higher rate of postpartum hemorrhage (9.1%) compared to those electing cesarean delivery (4.9%).
